Safety, Scope & Execution Guarantees

  • Strict Sandbox Isolation: All automated fixes write exclusively to tests/fixtures/sandbox/. Production files remain untouched.
  • Atomic Backups: Every applied patch creates a timestamped SQLite backup enabling instant one-click rollback.
  • SSRF Protection: Crawl engine rejects third-party origins and non-allowlisted network targets.
  • Zero Simulated Delays: Events and telemetry reflect actual Node.js HTTP fetches and Cheerio DOM parse operations.
